Description: This template authorizes an AWS IAM role against an existing Cloud Provider Access role registration on the MongoDB Atlas API, this will be billed to your Atlas account.

RoleId.Description: Id of the Cloud Provider Access role registration to authorize. It is returned by MongoDB::Atlas::CloudProviderAccessSetup.

IamAssumedRoleArn.Description: ARN of the AWS IAM role that MongoDB Cloud assumes when it accesses resources in your AWS account.

Profile.Description: Secret Manager Profile that contains the Atlas Programmatic keys.

AuthorizedDate.Description: Date and time when the role was authorized
